=== Da Bai Fen Duplicate ===

SEATS AND TEAMS: Seats are numbered 1, 2, 3, 4 in anticlockwise order. Team A is seats 1 and 3; Team B is seats 2 and 4. Play always proceeds anticlockwise: after seat 1 comes 2, then 3, then 4, then 1.

CARDS: The deck has 26 cards: the Big Joker (JOKER_BIG), the Small Joker (JOKER_SMALL), and four suits (Spades S, Hearts H, Clubs C, Diamonds D) each containing A, K, Q, J, 10, 5. Cards are written as suit letter plus rank, e.g. SA, H10, D5. Point values: a 5 is worth 5 points, a 10 is worth 10, a K is worth 10, and all other cards 0. Each suit holds 25 points, so the deck holds 100.

TRUMPS: Hands 1 and 3 have Spades as trump; hands 2 and 4 have Hearts as trump. The trumps are, from high to low: Big Joker, Small Joker, then A, K, Q, J, 10, 5 of the trump suit. Both jokers belong to the trump suit for following purposes. In every non-trump suit the order is A, K, Q, J, 10, 5.

THE MATCH has 4 hands of 6 tricks each, 24 rounds in total. Each round is one trick.

DEALING: At the start of hand 1 the cards are shuffled at random. Each seat receives 6 cards, private to that seat, and the remaining 2 cards form the kitty, face down and seen by no one. Hand 2 is a new random shuffle, dealt the same way. Hand 3 replays hand 1: every seat receives the exact cards held in hand 1 by the seat before it in seat order (seat 2 gets seat 1's hand 1 cards, seat 3 gets seat 2's, seat 4 gets seat 3's, seat 1 gets seat 4's), and the kitty is the same 2 cards. Hand 4 replays hand 2 in the same rotated way. Players are told when a hand is a replay.

FIRST LEADER of each hand: seat 1 in hand 1, seat 2 in hand 2, seat 2 in hand 3, seat 3 in hand 4. In each replay, the first leader holds the same cards as the first leader of the original hand.

A TRICK: The leader plays any one card from their hand face up. Then the other three seats, in anticlockwise order, each play one card, seeing all cards already played to the trick. Following: if the led card is a trump (a joker or a trump-suit card), each player must play a trump if they hold one. Otherwise each player must play a card of the led suit if they hold one. A player with no card of the required suit may play any card. You are offered only your legal cards. Winning: if any trump was played, the highest trump wins the trick. Otherwise the highest card of the led suit wins. Off-suit non-trump cards never win.

AFTER EACH TRICK: All four cards are announced along with the winner. The winner's team adds the point value of the four cards to its match total. The winner leads the next trick of the same hand.

END OF HAND: After the 6th trick the kitty is revealed. Its point value multiplied by 2 is added to the match total of the team that won the 6th trick. The next hand begins with its own deal and first leader.

INFORMATION: You always see your own cards, all cards played so far in the hand, both teams' match totals, the trump suit, the trick number and the hand number. Other players' hands and the kitty stay hidden until the kitty is revealed at the end of the hand. There is no table talk.

WINNING: After hand 4, the team with the higher match total (captured card points plus doubled kitty points) wins; both partners win. If the totals are equal, the match is a draw and all four seats share it.

--- Your place at the table ---

Players: 4. Seats are numbered 1 to 4.
You are seat 1, Ada. Seats are referred to by number.

Each round runs in this order: the hand begins → a fresh deal → a replayed deal → a new hand → a replayed hand → your cards → the lead → the second card → the third card → the fourth card → the trick is won → the trick result → the kitty → the end of the hand → clear the trick → after the last hand.

  the_fourth_card answer with one of the options you are given

  YOUR_TURN        Your turn to act. Reply with exactly one action,
                   in the format the message states.
  ACTION_REJECTED  Your last answer was not legal. Answer again.
  GAME_END         The match is over.

THE MATCH has 4 hands of 6 tricks each, 24 rounds in total. Each round is one trick.

DEALING: At the start of hand 1 the cards are shuffled at random. Each seat receives 6 cards, private to that seat, and the remaining 2 cards form the kitty, face down and seen by no one. Hand 2 is a new random shuffle, dealt the same way. A TRICK: The leader plays any one card from their hand face up. Then the other three seats, in anticlockwise order, each play one card, seeing all cards already played to the trick. AFTER EACH TRICK: All four cards are announced along with the winner. The winner's team adds the point value of the four cards to its match total. The winner leads the next trick of the same hand.

END OF HAND: After the 6th trick the kitty is revealed. Its point value multiplied by 2 is added to the match total of the team that won the 6th trick. The next hand begins with its own deal and first leader.

END OF HAND: After the 6th trick the kitty is revealed. Its point value multiplied by 2 is added to the match total of the team that won the 6th trick. The next hand begins with its own deal and first leader.

SEATS AND TEAMS: Seats are numbered 1, 2, 3, 4 in anticlockwise order. Team A is seats 1 and 3; Team B is seats 2 and 4. Play always proceeds anticlockwise: after seat 1 comes 2, then 3, then 4, then 1.

Cards are written as suit letter plus rank, e.g. SA, H10, D5. Point values: a 5 is worth 5 points, a 10 is worth 10, a K is worth 10, and all other cards 0. Each suit holds 25 points, so the deck holds 100.

TRUMPS: Hands 1 and 3 have Spades as trump; hands 2 and 4 have Hearts as trump. The trumps are, from high to low: Big Joker, Small Joker, then A, K, Q, J, 10, 5 of the trump suit. Both jokers belong to the trump suit for following purposes. In every non-trump suit the order is A, K, Q, J, 10, 5.

THE MATCH has 4 hands of 6 tricks each, 24 rounds in total. Each round is one trick.

DEALING: At the start of hand 1 the cards are shuffled at random. Each seat receives 6 cards, private to that seat, and the remaining 2 cards form the kitty, face down and seen by no one. Hand 2 is a new random shuffle, dealt the same way. Hand 3 replays hand 1: every seat receives the exact cards held in hand 1 by the seat before it in seat order (seat 2 gets seat 1's hand 1 cards, seat 3 gets seat 2's, seat 4 gets seat 3's, seat 1 gets seat 4's), and the kitty is the same 2 cards. Hand 4 replays hand 2 in the same rotated way. Players are told when a hand is a replay.

FIRST LEADER of each hand: seat 1 in hand 1, seat 2 in hand 2, seat 2 in hand 3, seat 3 in hand 4. In each replay, the first leader holds the same cards as the first leader of the original hand.

A TRICK: The leader plays any one card from their hand face up. Then the other three seats, in anticlockwise order, each play one card, seeing all cards already played to the trick. Following: if the led card is a trump (a joker or a trump-suit card), each player must play a trump if they hold one. Otherwise each player must play a card of the led suit if they hold one. A player with no card of the required suit may play any card. You are offered only your legal cards. Winning: if any trump was played, the highest trump wins the trick. Otherwise the highest card of the led suit wins. Off-suit non-trump cards never win.

AFTER EACH TRICK: All four cards are announced along with the winner. The winner's team adds the point value of the four cards to its match total. The winner leads the next trick of the same hand.

END OF HAND: After the 6th trick the kitty is revealed. Its point value multiplied by 2 is added to the match total of the team that won the 6th trick. The next hand begins with its own deal and first leader.

INFORMATION: You always see your own cards, all cards played so far in the hand, both teams' match totals, the trump suit, the trick number and the hand number. Other players' hands and the kitty stay hidden until the kitty is revealed at the end of the hand. There is no table talk.

WINNING: After hand 4, the team with the higher match total (captured card points plus doubled kitty points) wins; both partners win. If the totals are equal, the match is a draw and all four seats share it.

Each suit holds 25 points, so the deck holds 100.

TRUMPS: Hands 1 and 3 have Spades as trump; hands 2 and 4 have Hearts as trump. The trumps are, from high to low: Big Joker, Small Joker, then A, K, Q, J, 10, 5 of the trump suit. Both jokers belong to the trump suit for following purposes. In every non-trump suit the order is A, K, Q, J, 10, 5.

THE MATCH has 4 hands of 6 tricks each, 24 rounds in total. Each round is one trick.

DEALING: At the start of hand 1 the cards are shuffled at random. Each seat receives 6 cards, private to that seat, and the remaining 2 cards form the kitty, face down and seen by no one. Hand 2 is a new random shuffle, dealt the same way. Hand 3 replays hand 1: every seat receives the exact cards held in hand 1 by the seat before it in seat order (seat 2 gets seat 1's hand 1 cards, seat 3 gets seat 2's, seat 4 gets seat 3's, seat 1 gets seat 4's), and the kitty is the same 2 cards. A TRICK: The leader plays any one card from their hand face up. Then the other three seats, in anticlockwise order, each play one card, seeing all cards already played to the trick. A player with no card of the required suit may play any card. You are offered only your legal cards. Winning: if any trump was played, the highest trump wins the trick. AFTER EACH TRICK: All four cards are announced along with the winner. The winner's team adds the point value of the four cards to its match total. The winner leads the next trick of the same hand.

END OF HAND: After the 6th trick the kitty is revealed. Its point value multiplied by 2 is added to the match total of the team that won the 6th trick. The next hand begins with its own deal and first leader.

INFORMATION: You always see your own cards, all cards played so far in the hand, both teams' match totals, the trump suit, the trick number and the hand number. Other players' hands and the kitty stay hidden until the kitty is revealed at the end of the hand. There is no table talk.

END OF HAND: After the 6th trick the kitty is revealed. Its point value multiplied by 2 is added to the match total of the team that won the 6th trick. The next hand begins with its own deal and first leader.

THE MATCH has 4 hands of 6 tricks each, 24 rounds in total. Each round is one trick.

DEALING: At the start of hand 1 the cards are shuffled at random. Each seat receives 6 cards, private to that seat, and the remaining 2 cards form the kitty, face down and seen by no one. Hand 2 is a new random shuffle, dealt the same way. Hand 3 replays hand 1: every seat receives the exact cards held in hand 1 by the seat before it in seat order (seat 2 gets seat 1's hand 1 cards, seat 3 gets seat 2's, seat 4 gets seat 3's, seat 1 gets seat 4's), and the kitty is the same 2 cards. END OF HAND: After the 6th trick the kitty is revealed. Its point value multiplied by 2 is added to the match total of the team that won the 6th trick. The next hand begins with its own deal and first leader.

THE MATCH has 4 hands of 6 tricks each, 24 rounds in total. Each round is one trick.

DEALING: At the start of hand 1 the cards are shuffled at random. Each seat receives 6 cards, private to that seat, and the remaining 2 cards form the kitty, face down and seen by no one. Hand 2 is a new random shuffle, dealt the same way. Hand 3 replays hand 1: every seat receives the exact cards held in hand 1 by the seat before it in seat order (seat 2 gets seat 1's hand 1 cards, seat 3 gets seat 2's, seat 4 gets seat 3's, seat 1 gets seat 4's), and the kitty is the same 2 cards. A player with no card of the required suit may play any card. You are offered only your legal cards. Winning: if any trump was played, the highest trump wins the trick. END OF HAND: After the 6th trick the kitty is revealed. Its point value multiplied by 2 is added to the match total of the team that won the 6th trick. The next hand begins with its own deal and first leader.

records.system:
You are reviewing a game that has finished. You were not a player. You are shown everything: the messages the table was told, every move, and each player's private thinking at every move, which no other player ever saw. Each move carries the notes its game asked for, under their own names. The usual ones are:

  plan     what they meant to do over the coming turns
  reason   why they made that move
  predict  what they expected their opponents to do
  adjust   how they changed their own strategy because of that

Write two things.

First, a summary of the whole game as it unfolded: the turning points, the moves that decided it, and how it ended. Concrete: name seats, rounds and numbers.

Second, a review of each player. Judge their play, not their luck. For each one, compare their predictions with what their opponents were actually thinking and actually did: were they right, and did they see it in time? Did their adjustments follow from their predictions, and did their moves follow from their reasons? Point out their best and worst moves. Then score their play from 1 to 10, where 1 is aimless or self-defeating and 10 is sharp, well read and well executed. A player can lose and still score well, or win and score badly.

A player who gave no reasons, predictions or adjustments is judged on their moves alone; say that their thinking was not recorded.

Refer to each player by seat, and as "they".

THE GAME
SEATS AND TEAMS: Seats are numbered 1, 2, 3, 4 in anticlockwise order. Team A is seats 1 and 3; Team B is seats 2 and 4. Play always proceeds anticlockwise: after seat 1 comes 2, then 3, then 4, then 1.

CARDS: The deck has 26 cards: the Big Joker (JOKER_BIG), the Small Joker (JOKER_SMALL), and four suits (Spades S, Hearts H, Clubs C, Diamonds D) each containing A, K, Q, J, 10, 5. Cards are written as suit letter plus rank, e.g. SA, H10, D5. Point values: a 5 is worth 5 points, a 10 is worth 10, a K is worth 10, and all other cards 0. Each suit holds 25 points, so the deck holds 100.

TRUMPS: Hands 1 and 3 have Spades as trump; hands 2 and 4 have Hearts as trump. The trumps are, from high to low: Big Joker, Small Joker, then A, K, Q, J, 10, 5 of the trump suit. Both jokers belong to the trump suit for following purposes. In every non-trump suit the order is A, K, Q, J, 10, 5.

THE MATCH has 4 hands of 6 tricks each, 24 rounds in total. Each round is one trick.

DEALING: At the start of hand 1 the cards are shuffled at random. Each seat receives 6 cards, private to that seat, and the remaining 2 cards form the kitty, face down and seen by no one. Hand 2 is a new random shuffle, dealt the same way. Hand 3 replays hand 1: every seat receives the exact cards held in hand 1 by the seat before it in seat order (seat 2 gets seat 1's hand 1 cards, seat 3 gets seat 2's, seat 4 gets seat 3's, seat 1 gets seat 4's), and the kitty is the same 2 cards. Hand 4 replays hand 2 in the same rotated way. Players are told when a hand is a replay.

FIRST LEADER of each hand: seat 1 in hand 1, seat 2 in hand 2, seat 2 in hand 3, seat 3 in hand 4. In each replay, the first leader holds the same cards as the first leader of the original hand.

A TRICK: The leader plays any one card from their hand face up. Then the other three seats, in anticlockwise order, each play one card, seeing all cards already played to the trick. Following: if the led card is a trump (a joker or a trump-suit card), each player must play a trump if they hold one. Otherwise each player must play a card of the led suit if they hold one. A player with no card of the required suit may play any card. You are offered only your legal cards. Winning: if any trump was played, the highest trump wins the trick. Otherwise the highest card of the led suit wins. Off-suit non-trump cards never win.

AFTER EACH TRICK: All four cards are announced along with the winner. The winner's team adds the point value of the four cards to its match total. The winner leads the next trick of the same hand.

END OF HAND: After the 6th trick the kitty is revealed. Its point value multiplied by 2 is added to the match total of the team that won the 6th trick. The next hand begins with its own deal and first leader.

INFORMATION: You always see your own cards, all cards played so far in the hand, both teams' match totals, the trump suit, the trick number and the hand number. Other players' hands and the kitty stay hidden until the kitty is revealed at the end of the hand. There is no table talk.

WINNING: After hand 4, the team with the higher match total (captured card points plus doubled kitty points) wins; both partners win. If the totals are equal, the match is a draw and all four seats share it.
